name: Cardiotocography resampling benchmark
description: A benchmarking study that evaluates multi-class resampling methods on cardiotocography data for fetal health classification under class imbalance.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark used in research on class-imbalance mitigation for fetal health classification; not a broadly adopted general benchmark.
notes: Small, imbalanced medical/tabular dataset; results sensitive to resampling strategy and preprocessing. Non-LLM benchmark with limited scale and potential overfitting risks.
